notifications.title: The workers typecheck fails on main, so every agent branch that touches workers/ is blocked
notifications.detail: `cd workers && npm run typecheck` fails on main with two errors under noUncheckedIndexedAccess. One is in apps/dashboard/src/lib/posting-plan.ts (lines 90 and 96, `splice(i, 1)[0]` may be undefined); tonight's auditor branch fixes that. The other is in workers/lib/publishing.ts line 99, `slots[i + 1].getTime()` ('Object is possibly undefined'), inside missedSlots; that file is owner-locked, so no agent can fix it. Until it is fixed, the merge workflow's 'Worker typecheck and tests' step fails for any branch with a file under workers/, so data-bug fixes with worker tests can't land (the auditor is holding one: promo Shorts on the Queue page ignore the owner's pick).
notifications.fix: 1. In workers/lib/publishing.ts line 99, change `u.getTime() < slots[i + 1].getTime()` to `u.getTime() < slots[i + 1]!.getTime()` (the `i + 1 >= slots.length ||` before it already guards it). 2. Run `cd workers && npm run typecheck && npm test`. 3. Commit to main.

notifications.title: The daily data audit lands after the auditor starts, so tonight's numbers went unchecked
notifications.detail: data-audit.yml is scheduled at 08:23 UTC (13:53 IST), but GitHub starts it many hours late: the newest audit on main was written 25 Nov 18:43 UTC (00:13 IST). Tonight's auditor started at 16:33 UTC (22:03 IST), when that audit was 22 hours old, so the dashboard-vs-YouTube check was skipped again (third night in four).
notifications.fix: Optional. 1. In .github/workflows/data-audit.yml move the cron earlier, e.g. "23 2 * * *" (07:53 IST), so even an 8-hour delay lands before the 22:00 to 23:00 IST auditor run; or 2. start the auditor routine later (after 23:30 IST). Workflows and routine times are owner-only.

notifications.title: renderer/thumbs.py downloads from YouTube, against the no-network rule
notifications.detail: search_refs scrapes YouTube's search page and fetch_thumb downloads thumbnails from i.ytimg.com, both inside renderer/. CLAUDE.md says the renderer never uses the network, and the guard blocks any agent branch that adds such a line there. The code reached main directly, so the guard never checked it. (Moved here from Paisa Panchayat's notifications when that channel was deleted on 23 Nov; still open.)
notifications.fix: Choose one: 1. Move search_refs, fetch_thumb and refs_sheet into generator/thumb_refs.py (routine-side, where research tools belong) and import them from there; or 2. if the renderer should keep them, say so in CLAUDE.md, so agents know the exception.

notifications.title: One bad setting row resets every setting to its default
notifications.detail: workers/lib/settings.ts validates the merged settings as one object and falls back to the defaults for everything when any row fails (its comment says bad rows are ignored). A row edited by hand in Supabase with a wrong type would quietly switch the uploads pause off and restore the default upload times and daily target in every worker; the dashboard's getSettings does the same. The file is protected, so the auditor can't change it. (Moved here from Paisa Panchayat's notifications when that channel was deleted; still open.)
notifications.fix: 1. In a Claude Code session: in workers/lib/settings.ts, validate each row with SettingsSchema.shape[key].safeParse(row.value), keep the default only for rows that fail and print a ::warning:: naming the key. 2. Do the same in apps/dashboard/src/lib/store.db.ts getSettings. 3. Add a test with one bad row while uploads are paused.

notifications.title: The hourly watchdog runs only every 4-11 hours
notifications.detail: watchdog.yml is scheduled every hour, but GitHub ran it 11 times between 7 Nov 09:58 and 10 Nov 09:42 UTC (gaps of 4-11 hours). The hourly view snapshots behind the dashboard's 'realtime' chart and the 48-hour views therefore have gaps, and owner alerts can arrive hours late. (Moved here from Paisa Panchayat's notifications when that channel was deleted; still open.)
notifications.fix: Optional. 1. Accept it, or 2. start watchdog.yml from the Netlify publish heartbeat the way Publish is started (workflows are owner-only files).
